# Lighting, aux fuse blocks and dual batteries

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Pull out the old bulb and insert a new LED that may need rotating to light. [t1]

Route and secure 7-pin wiring harness components while installing a receiver into the rear bumper. [t6]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Remove the side strip from the passenger kick panel by pulling it with even pressure.
2. Detach the two white pop clips holding the side strip in place.
3. Pop out the two retainers on the side of the truck to free the main kick panel.
4. Pull and release the single retainer located on the floor beneath the panel.
5. Locate three relays inside the cabin that require fuses based on your specific wiring setup.
6. Wrap foam tape around each relay and zip tie them securely in place.
7. Reattach the side kick panel by placing white clips into their retainers.
8. Push down along the entire length of the bottom rail to ensure it is fully clipped in.
9. Drop out the spare tire from the rear of the truck for easier access.
10. Separate the black plug on the driver's rear quarter panel from its mounting location.
11. Route the separated black plug back near the grey factory plug.
12. Remove the protective caps from both the grey and black plugs to expose their contacts.
13. Plug in the corresponding pieces of the new 7-pin wiring harness into the exposed connectors.
14. Zip tie all connected wires together for neatness before routing them along the frame.
15. Secure the cable run using the mounting brackets already attached to the harness kit.
16. Tape off sections of the rear bumper to outline where the receiver will fit.
17. Drill a hole in the marked spot on the bumper using a bi-metal bit at a medium pace with constant pressure.
18. Spray WD40 onto the bumper and drill bit periodically to keep them cool while drilling.
19. Clean up any metal shards from inside and around the fresh hole using a dremel tool.
20. Trim a small section on the right side of the drilled circle if necessary for clearance.
21. Unclip the receiver unit from its connection point on the wiring harness temporarily.
22. Trim the edges on the backside of the receiver to prevent it from hitting surrounding parts.
23. Place the trimmed receiver into the bumper hole and mark the location for the first drill point.
24. Drill out the second hole at the marked position next to the first one.
25. Bolt the receiver securely to the bumper through both drilled holes.
26. Reconnect the wiring harness back onto the mounted receiver.

_Procedure reported by [t6]. Photos of this job are in the source: <https://www.thenewx.org/threads/how-to-install-7-pin-wiring-harness.4849/>_

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t1] [Partial]</summary>

1. [Partial] Pull out the old bulb from the socket.
2. Insert the new LED bulb into the same position.

</details>

## Tips & gotchas

- Use even pressure when pulling the side strip to avoid damage. [t6]
- Drill at a medium pace with constant pressure rather than running too fast. [t6]
